<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862. This matches a sodium adduct ([M+Na]⁺) of a neutral molecule with monoisotopic mass ≈ 171.097 Da. The formula C₈H₁₃NO₃ has a calculated neutral mass of 171.0895 Da, and adding Na (22.9892 Da) gives 194.0787 Da, within the experimental tolerance. This formula also yields an integer double‑bond equivalent, supporting its plausibility. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C₈H₁₃O₃N.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H13O3N</final_answer>
